canonical_project: Mohale's Hoek Government Data Centre (National Data Centre)
owner: Government of Lesotho / Ministry of Communications, Science and Technology (e-Gov project)
notes: gov.ls articles confirm the Mohale's Hoek data centre built under the Lesotho e-Government Infrastructure Project Phase I (National Data Centre, per communications.gov.ls); power house construction and furniture/equipment adverts indicate commissioning/integration stage. 2021 EOI covers operationalisation of Mohale's Hoek DC and integration of the three government data centres (two others' locations undisclosed).
